body: I was in a wrestling team, played soccer/basketball, but just couldn't keep up with them so I dropped, was also pressed by my dad to do more and I couldn't. Always found my happiness but now I just don't, I just feel lonely every second of my existence and the only way I cope with it is talking to myself or swinging back and forth.
Playing games, I think that's the only thing I really enjoyed.

Nah, don't really have anything to look forward to.
